scope: Synthetic English audio track -> native Chrome SpeechRecognition -> production speech controller and rendered captions
limitations: Synthetic audio was injected only at the native recognition start(audioTrack) capture boundary; recognition events were not synthesized.
Physical microphone capture and the default no-argument start() capture path were not exercised by this hour-long run.
The error code network does not establish the underlying cause of interruptions.
Matching native final and rendered row counts does not establish perfect transcription or zero lost words.
Maximum final-result gap is not end-to-end translation or answer latency.
JavaScript heap samples are not total browser memory and do not prove the absence of all memory leaks.
Background/sleep recovery, Bluetooth changes, translation and paid AI services were not exercised by this hour-long run.
